name: datarust Agent
description: Autonomous classical machine learning, feature preprocessing, and automated dataset profiling agent native to Rust with bit-level scikit-learn parity.

skills.name: datarust Data Profiling
skills.description: Automated dataset profiling, distribution statistics, pairwise relationships (Pearson, Cramér's V, point-biserial), target leakage hints, and data quality checks with datarust-profile.
examples: Profile dataset columns and calculate descriptive statistics
Detect target leakage between feature columns and label
Compute pairwise correlation heatmap and quality report

skills.name: datarust Classical Machine Learning
skills.description: Scikit-learn-style preprocessing, feature engineering, and classical machine learning estimators (linear regression, ridge, logistic regression, k-means, decision trees) in Rust with datarust.
examples: Fit an ordinary least squares linear regression model
Scale numerical features using StandardScaler or RobustScaler
Build a scikit-learn compatible pipeline in Rust
